race_definitions.title: Positions 1–4 (Champions League). Teams in GW31: Arsenal (no fixture), Man City, Man United, Aston Villa
race_definitions.top5: Within 5 points of 5th place (Chelsea, 48pts) → 43pts+ qualifies. Priority over European. Teams: Chelsea (no fixture), Liverpool, Brentford, Everton (no fixture)
race_definitions.european: Within 4 points of 6th place (Liverpool, 48pts) → 44pts+ qualifies. Only applies if team NOT already tagged Top 5. GW31: no eligible fixtures (all qualifying teams already captured by Top 5)

_meta.priority_rule: Title > Top 5 > European. A fixture appears in ONE category only — the highest that applies.
notes: Chelsea and Everton have no GW31 PL fixture.
Newcastle (42pts) misses both thresholds (need 43+ for Top 5, 44+ for European).
European filter is empty for GW31 — every 44pt+ team also qualifies for Top 5, so Top 5 wins.
European filter will populate in future GWs as standings diverge.

fixtures.race_notes: Brentford (7th, 44pts) — qualifies for both Top 5 and European, but Top 5 takes priority. Win here keeps them in the Europa League hunt. Wolves not in any race.
Man United (3rd, 51pts) — must win to keep pressure on Arsenal and hold off a chasing pack. Title race critical fixture. Bournemouth not in any race.
Liverpool (6th, 48pts) — level on pts with Chelsea in 5th but with a game in hand. Win puts them above Chelsea. Qualifies for both but Top 5 takes priority. Brighton not in any race.
Fulham (12th) comfortably mid-table. Burnley (19th) relegation battle. No title/top5/european relevance.
Man City (2nd, 61pts) — 9 points behind Arsenal. Cannot afford slip-ups. Title race fixture. Crystal Palace not in any race.
Newcastle (9th, 42pts) — falls short of both thresholds (need 43+ for top5, 44+ for european). No race tag. Sunderland (13th) mid-table, no race relevance.
Aston Villa (4th, 51pts) — level with Man United on pts, separated only by GD. Drop points and Chelsea/Liverpool can capitalise. Title race fixture. West Ham in relegation battle.
Both teams in or near relegation zone. No title/top5/european relevance.
